fomod.Name: THE WORLD - ZA WARUDO (Time Stop)
fomod.Author: TheDoctorDev
fomod.Description: Stop time itself in Fallout: New Vegas! Freeze enemies, suspend bullets in mid-air, and unleash everything when time resumes. Inspired by JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, featuring iconic visual effects, optional DIO and Jotaro voices, and customizable gameplay presets.
